shared_elements: frontal or profile human faces with rendered eye and hair
patterned band framing the composition (rosette-like/floral repeats vs. petal-like fringe)
ornamented dress with incised parallel-line texture
relief carving with raised outlined forms
justification: Both surfaces show human figures in low relief with garments rendered by fine parallel incised lines, and both have a repeated petal/rosette-like decorative border, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise the content diverges sharply: A is a single frontal, symmetrical, multi-limbed seated figure surrounded by radiating petal forms, while B is a horizontal narrative procession of profile attendants leading a two-humped camel with a lead rope and carrying offerings.
